about.title: About
about.desc: F&V is the internal study, diagnostics and field tools app for the technical team of Factronics, C.A.
about.disclaimer: Internal program of Factronics, C.A. Not an official Videojet Technologies certification.
about.licenses: This app uses open-source libraries (AndroidX, Jetpack Compose, Kotlin, React and i18next). Real technical data will only be published with a source and review.
about.privacy: Privacy: the app requests no unnecessary permissions. Your personal data stays on the device.
about.translationsPending: UI translations: pending review by native speakers.
settings.festivity.note: Calculated from the device date and time zone. You can disable it, force a festivity or use sober mode.

packs.installDemoNote: Authorized DEMO pack (ADR-0003) to try the app offline. It contains no real data.
packs.clearConfirm: Installed content will be removed from this device.
packs.noBackup: There are no backups on this device.
search.title: Search content
search.placeholder: Search by text, ID or code
search.empty.title: No results
errors.packCorrupt: The pack file is damaged or invalid.
errors.hashInvalid: File integrity does not match (invalid hash).
errors.signatureMissing: The pack has no digital signature.
errors.signatureInvalid: The pack's digital signature is not valid.
errors.unknownKey: The pack's signing key is not trusted.
errors.futureVersion: The pack requires a future schema version; it is never installed blindly.
errors.downgrade: The pack is older than the installed one: downgrade blocked.
errors.clientVersion: This pack requires a newer version of the app.
errors.invalidContent: The content does not meet the provenance rules (no source, no publish).
errors.order: Intermediate updates are missing: try syncing again.
errors.backupCorrupt: The backup is damaged and will not be restored.
errors.backupBig: The backup exceeds the allowed size.
errors.diskFull: There is not enough space on the device.
errors.writeInterrupted: The write was interrupted: reverted to the previous state.
errors.migrationFailed: The local store update failed: rolled back without losing content.
errors.unknown: Unexpected error while processing the pack.
